_source: The values action_center.py used before calibration existed, each measured by hand and documented at its old definition: cluster_title 0.40 (complete-linkage cut, #659 replay of the 2026-09-27 feed) and near_identical 0.92 (120 production issue pairs, 2026-07). cluster_title is the starting point action_thresholds.calibrate() replaces once it has MIN_PER_CLASS labelled pairs on each side; near_identical is not fitted (see action_thresholds' docstring). Regenerate this file from a calibration with scripts/calibrate_action_thresholds.py.
